reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Montana
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Does the law allow a landlord to include a lease provision whereby a tenant waives their right to notice?
*/

% --------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% --------------------------

state(montana).
focus_year(2021).

party(landlord1).
party(tenant1).

rental_agreement(lease1).
agreement_parties(lease1, landlord1, tenant1).

% The lease includes a provision where the tenant waives their right to notice.
provision(prov1).
agreement_has_provision(lease1, prov1).
provision_requires_party(prov1, tenant1).

% We model the provision as a waiver of a specific right: right_to_notice.
provision_type(prov1, waiver(right_to_notice)).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual scenario is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    state(montana),
    focus_year(2021),
    rental_agreement(lease1),
    agreement_parties(lease1, landlord1, tenant1),
    provision(prov1),
    agreement_has_provision(lease1, prov1),
    provision_requires_party(prov1, tenant1),
    provision_type(prov1, waiver(right_to_notice)).

% --------------------------
% Statute translation (Montana, 2021)
% --------------------------

/*
  MT Code  70-24-202 (2021) - Prohibited provisions in rental agreements.
  A rental agreement may not provide that a party:
    (1) agrees to waive or forego rights or remedies under this chapter; ...
*/

% For this question, we need to know whether "right_to_notice" is a right under this chapter.
% We encode that as a legal classification in the relevant jurisdiction/year.
right_or_remedy_under_chapter(montana, 2021, right_to_notice).

% A provision is a waiver/foregoing of rights if it has the waiver(Right) type.
provision_is_waiver_of_right(Provision, Right) :-
    provision_type(Provision, waiver(Right)).

% MT Code  70-24-202(1) (2021): prohibition on waiving/foregoing rights or remedies under this chapter.
statute_mt_70_24_202_1_prohibited_provision(Agreement, Provision) :-
    rental_agreement(Agreement),
    agreement_has_provision(Agreement, Provision),
    provision_requires_party(Provision, _Party),
    provision_is_waiver_of_right(Provision, Right),
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    right_or_remedy_under_chapter(State, Year, Right).

% A rental agreement contains a prohibited provision if any statute prohibition matches.
rental_agreement_contains_prohibited_provision(Agreement) :-
    statute_mt_70_24_202_1_prohibited_provision(Agreement, _Provision).

% --------------------------
% Reasoning to answer the question
% --------------------------

% The law allows inclusion if it is NOT prohibited; if prohibited, it is not allowed.
law_allows_including_waiver_of_notice_in_lease(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ rental_agreement_contains_prohibited_provision(lease1),
    !.
law_allows_including_waiver_of_notice_in_lease(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    rental_agreement_contains_prohibited_provision(lease1),
    !.

% Required API predicate.
housing_answer(Result) :-
    law_allows_including_waiver_of_notice_in_lease(Result),
    !.

% --------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% --------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law allow a landlord to include a lease provision whereby a tenant waives their right to notice?
